plan.tagline: Unifies network device data for easy management and monitoring
plan.problem: Indie hackers and small businesses struggle to manage and monitor their network devices efficiently
plan.solution: The Openrouter Fusion API provides a simple CLI tool to add, list, and report on network devices, with customizable alerts and notifications, all using a local SQLite database for offline access
plan.target_market: Indie hackers, developers, and small businesses worldwide
mvp_features: Add network devices to the database
List all network devices in the database
Generate reports on network device status

build_phases.name: Core DB + add
build_phases.description: Create SQLite schema and implement add and list commands

build_phases.name: Reports + alerts
build_phases.description: Implement report generation and notification system

build_phases.name: Demo + polish
build_phases.description: Implement --demo mode, --help, and edge case handling

plan.demo_script: The --demo mode shows a pre-populated database with 5 network devices, demonstrating add, list, and report functionality
